android.desc:
Pop. Combo. Conquer the sky!

Skyloons is a fast, juicy balloon pop game made for quick sessions. Tap balloons before they float away, chain combos for huge multipliers, dodge bombs and sneaky decoys, and battle giant boss balloons every 10 levels. Free to play, and it works offline.

WHY YOU'LL LOVE IT
• 100 levels across a colourful campaign, from a gentle first pop to frantic late-game chaos
• Giant BOSS battles every 10 levels: crack its health bar and dodge the minions and bombs it drops
• Something new every few levels: hearts, golden balloons, linked chains, splitters, sneaky decoys, freeze, rainbow, armored and clock balloons all play differently
• Build combo streaks for up to 5x points: pop fast, keep the streak alive and watch the multiplier climb
• Daily Missions: three fresh goals every day, plus a bonus chest for clearing all three
• A 7-day login calendar with bigger coin rewards the longer your streak runs
• Endless Mode: survive as long as you can while the balloons get faster and wilder, and chase your best time
• Daily Challenge: a fresh board every day, the same for every player. Can you beat your own best?
• Bonus goals on every level ("No misses", "10 in a row", "Pop 3 specials") for extra coins
• 7 unlockable worlds, each with its own sky and ambience, from Sunset Valley to a starry night
• Customise your game with 5 balloon skins, 8 pop effects and 6 trail styles. Pure cosmetics, never pay-to-win
• Track your lifetime stats and unlock achievements as you play
• Share your scores with friends and challenge them to beat you

HOW TO PLAY
Tap a rising balloon to pop it before it escapes off the top of the screen. Chain pops without missing to build your combo multiplier. Watch out for bombs and decoy balloons: popping those costs you a life. Grab golden balloons for big points, hearts for extra lives, and rainbow balloons for a temporary score boost. Every 10th level puts a giant boss balloon in your way, so keep tapping and dodge what it throws back.

FAIR PLAY, ALWAYS
Everything in the shop is cosmetic. Balloon skins, pop effects and trails change how the game looks, never how fast balloons move, how big they are, or how the game scores you. Every player faces the exact same challenge.

Skyloons plays fully offline. Only ads need an internet connection, and watching a rewarded ad is always optional.

Whether you have 30 seconds between meetings or an hour to chase a new best streak, Skyloons is built for qui
